title: Repo scaffold, Makefile, lint/test tooling
acceptance: Directory layout matches SPEC 13.1 (backend/app/{api,core,models,services,agents,adapters,notify}, backend/migrations, backend/tests/{unit,adapters/fixtures,integration,isolation,evals}, frontend, infra/{terraform,cloudrun}, evals/golden/{us,in}, .github/workflows)
backend/pyproject.toml managed by uv with pinned deps and uv.lock committed
make lint runs ruff format --check, ruff check and mypy on backend/app and exits 0
make test runs pytest with coverage and fails if backend/app/core coverage < 85%
make eval target exists and runs backend/tests/evals
.gitignore excludes .env, .venv, node_modules, logs/*.jsonl, __pycache__
.env.example lists every setting consumed by app/core/config.py

title: Docker Compose local stack
acceptance: infra/docker-compose.yml defines postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16), redis, minio, mailpit with healthchecks and named volumes
docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config validates
Postgres init script creates databases bidradar and bidradar_test with extensions vector and pg_trgm
make up / make down wrap compose; make db-reset drops and recreates the test database

title: FastAPI skeleton, settings, health and OpenAPI
acceptance: GET /healthz returns 200 {status:'ok', version}
All business routes mount under /api/v1 and openapi.json lists them
Settings load from env via pydantic-settings; LLM model IDs (opus/sonnet/haiku class), embedding provider, region, storage backend are settings not literals
Unit test asserts no hard-coded 'claude-' model id string exists outside app/core/config.py
Request-id middleware adds X-Request-ID to every response

title: SQLAlchemy 2 async engine, Alembic baseline, extensions, TenantMixin
acceptance: alembic upgrade head on an empty database creates extensions vector and pg_trgm
alembic downgrade base leaves no application tables
TenantMixin adds tenant_id uuid NOT NULL indexed column
Session factory sets SET LOCAL app.tenant_id from the request tenant on every transaction
Test database fixtures create a fresh schema per test session and truncate between tests

title: Tenancy tables: tenants, users, memberships, plan_limits, usage_ledger, audit_log
acceptance: Migration 0001 creates tenants(id, name, slug, region us|in, plan free|pro|enterprise, is_internal bool, data_residency, created_at)
users(id, email unique, name, tz, locale) and memberships(user_id, tenant_id, role) with role enum platform_admin|tenant_owner|bid_manager|writer|reviewer|viewer
plan_limits rows seeded for free (1 profile, 1 region, digest only, 0 drafts), pro (3 profiles, all sources, instant alerts, 10 drafts/month), enterprise (unlimited)
usage_ledger(tenant_id, metric, quantity, period, ref) and audit_log(tenant_id, user_id, action, object_type, object_id, ip, at, meta jsonb)
Unit tests cover model constraints (unique membership per user+tenant, role enum)

title: Row-level security on every tenant table
acceptance: Helper enable_rls(table) in migrations creates policy USING tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
Application DB role is not table owner and cannot bypass RLS
Test: rows inserted as tenant A are invisible when app.tenant_id = B
Test enumerates information_schema.columns for tenant_id and fails if any such table lacks an RLS policy
Platform-admin queries use an explicit bypass session that writes an audit_log row

title: Auth: Auth.js-compatible JWT verification, current user, tenant from token, RBAC
acceptance: Bearer JWT (HS256 shared secret AUTH_SECRET, Auth.js claims sub/email/tenant_id/role) verified by dependency get_current_user
Missing or invalid token returns 401; expired token returns 401
require_role(*roles) dependency returns 403 for insufficient role and passes for platform_admin only on admin routes
Tenant id is taken from the token, never from the request body or query
Auth rate limit: more than 20 failed auth attempts per IP per minute returns 429

title: Audit log service and middleware
acceptance: Every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE under /api/v1 writes an audit_log row with user, tenant, action, object, IP and request id
audit(action, object) helper is callable from services for reads that must be logged (draft and export reads)
Admin support access to a tenant writes an audit_log row with action support_access
Audit rows are append-only: UPDATE and DELETE are revoked for the application role

title: Seed script for internal tenant and platform admin
acceptance: make seed creates tenant slug 'internal' with is_internal=true, plan enterprise, region us
Creates platform admin user from SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL env and membership role platform_admin
Running make seed twice is idempotent (no duplicate rows)
Internal tenant bypasses plan limits (test asserts unlimited profiles)

title: CI workflow: lint, tests with Postgres and Redis services, coverage gate
acceptance: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on push and pull_request
Jobs: backend-lint, backend-test (services pgvector/pgvector:pg16 and redis:7), frontend-lint-build
backend-test fails when core coverage < 85% or any test fails
Workflow YAML validates with a yaml parser test in tests/unit/test_ci_config.py

title: Tenant isolation test harness over every route
acceptance: tests/isolation/test_cross_tenant.py creates tenants A and B with one owner each and sample objects for A
Harness discovers every route from app.openapi() and, for each path with an {id} param, calls it as B with A's ids
Any 2xx response whose body contains A's object id fails the build
New routes are covered automatically; routes needing custom payloads register a factory in tests/isolation/factories.py and the test fails if a route has no factory
Suite runs in CI as its own step

title: Plan limits enforcement service
acceptance: PlanService.check(tenant, resource, requested=1) reads plan_limits and current usage
Exceeding a limit raises PlanLimitExceeded mapped to HTTP 402 with the limit name
is_internal tenants always pass
Unit tests cover profiles, source regions, agent drafts/month with period rollover

title: Frontend scaffold with Auth.js and generated API client
acceptance: frontend/ is Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, pnpm build passes
Auth.js configured with email magic link, Google and Microsoft providers reading secrets from env; session JWT carries tenant_id and role
pnpm gen:api regenerates a typed client from backend openapi.json into src/lib/api/
Sign-in page and an authenticated /app layout with region badge render
pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck pass

title: company_profiles table with identity and registrations (4.1) and field-level encryption
acceptance: Migration 0002 creates company_profiles with every 4.1 field, region flag and addresses jsonb array
EIN, PAN, GSTIN, TAN and bank details are AES-GCM encrypted via a KMS-style EncryptedString type keyed from FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY
API responses mask encrypted fields to last 4 characters
UEI validated as 12 alphanumeric chars, CAGE as 5 chars; SAM expiry stored as date
US-only and IN-only fields are rejected with 422 when the profile region does not match

title: Size, finance and socio-economic status (4.2)
acceptance: Fields: employee counts by country, annual revenue last 3 FY (currency, fiscal year), net worth, solvency cert flag, audited FY list, bonding/BG limit
certifications table stores socio-economic certs (8a, hubzone, wosb, edwosb, sdvosb, vosb, sdb) with cert number and expiry
IN fields: Udyam number + category micro|small|medium, DPIIT number, SC/ST- or women-owned MSE enum
Average of last 3 FY turnover computed in core.finance with currency preserved

title: What we sell: profile_codes, profile_keywords, service_lines (4.3)
acceptance: profile_codes(profile_id, scheme naics|psc|aln|gem|india_category, code, is_primary)
NAICS codes validated against a bundled 2022 NAICS table (backend/app/core/data/naics_2022.csv); unknown code returns 422
profile_keywords(kind include|exclude, term, weight 0.1-5.0)
service_lines(name, description <= 150 words enforced, differentiators, tools, delivery_model)
Unit tests for validation edge cases

title: Where and how big: geography, buyers, value range, notice and contract types, teaming (4.4)
acceptance: Fields: target countries, US states, Indian states/UTs, cities, remote_ok, target buyers, blocked buyers
Value range min/max per currency USD and INR
notice_types_wanted and contract_types_preferred multi-enums match SPEC 5.3 notice_type values
teaming_partners(name, uei, pan, capabilities, relationship prime|sub|jv)
Round-trip test through the API

title: Proof for drafting: past performance, personnel, security, insurance, boilerplate, files, vehicles, registrations (4.5)
acceptance: past_performance with every 4.5 column incl. public/confidential flag and CPARS rating
personnel(name, role, years, clearances, certifications, education, resume_file_id)
registrations(kind sam|dsc|gem|cppp|state_portal, identifier, holder, expiry) and vehicles(vehicle, number, expiry)
Security/compliance attestations (FCL, CMMC, FedRAMP, SOC2, ISO, CMMI, STQC/CERT-In) and insurance(kind, limit, expiry)
boilerplate_blocks(kind, title, body rich text) and profile_files(kind capability_statement|brochure|case_study|past_proposal|brand|template, metadata jsonb)
Labor categories / rate card table with currency

title: Preferences: notification prefs, thresholds, bid/no-bid weights, languages (4.6)
acceptance: user_notification_prefs(user_id, tenant_id, channels_by_event jsonb, quiet_hours_start/end, tz, digest_time, min_score_instant default 70, min_score_digest default 50)
Profile-level scoring weights jsonb defaulting to SPEC 6 weights and validated to sum to 100
Bid/no-bid criteria weights and required approver roles stored on the profile
Output languages list defaults to ['en']; 'hi' allowed for IN profiles

title: SBA small-business status auto-computed per NAICS
acceptance: Bundled SBA size standards table (NAICS -> receipts or employee threshold) in core/data
core.eligibility.small_business_status(naics, avg_receipts, employees) returns small|other_than_small|unknown
Unit tests: receipts-based and employee-based codes, missing data -> unknown
Computed statuses exposed on GET /profiles/{id} as size_status_by_naics

title: Profile completeness score
acceptance: core.profile.completeness(profile) returns 0-100 with a per-section breakdown
matching_enabled is true at >= 40; drafting_enabled requires >= 70 and >= 3 past performance records
Region-specific fields only count for that region
Deterministic unit tests for an empty, half-filled and full profile

title: Profile REST API with sub-resources
acceptance: GET/PUT /api/v1/profiles/{id}; POST /api/v1/profiles creates within plan limits
Sub-resources CRUD: codes, keywords, service-lines, past-performance, personnel, certifications, registrations, files, boilerplate, teaming-partners
Writer role may edit past performance and personnel; viewer gets 403 on writes
Isolation factories registered for every profile route
Round-trip test: create full profile via API and read it back equal (masked fields excepted)

title: Profile autofill from website, capability PDF and UEI
acceptance: POST /api/v1/profiles/{id}/autofill accepts website_url, capability_file_id, uei and returns suggestions[] with field, value, source, confidence; it never writes the profile
Website path fetches the page politely (adapters/http) and extracts with the Haiku-class model via JSON schema
UEI path calls the SAM.gov Entity API (recorded fixture) and maps legal name, address, CAGE, NAICS, registration expiry
Capability PDF path parses text and extracts service lines, certifications, past performance candidates
Tests use FakeLLM and recorded fixtures only

title: File upload service: allow-list, size cap, virus scan hook, storage abstraction
acceptance: Storage protocol with implementations local (tests), S3-compatible (MinIO) and GCS; per-region bucket chosen from tenant.data_residency
Uploads over 50 MB or outside the allow-list (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, png, jpg, txt, csv) return 413/415
Scanner protocol with ClamAV implementation and NoopScanner in tests; infected file is rejected and audited
Signed download URLs expire (default 15 min)
Raw archive path helper builds raw/{source}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{external_id}/{fetched_at}

title: Tenant knowledge base: kb_chunks with embeddings and EmbeddingProvider
acceptance: EmbeddingProvider protocol (embed(texts) -> list[1024 floats]); VoyageProvider default, FakeEmbeddings deterministic in tests
kb_chunks(tenant_id, profile_id, source_type, source_id, chunk_index, text, page, embedding vector(1024))
Indexing job chunks profile files, boilerplate, past performance and service lines; re-index on change
similarity_search(profile_id, query, k) returns only the tenant's chunks (isolation test)

title: Frontend onboarding wizard (7 steps) with autofill and completeness meter
acceptance: Steps: 1 Identity & registrations, 2 Size & status, 3 What we sell, 4 Where & how big, 5 Proof, 6 Preferences, 7 Review
Region choice at sign-up hides fields for the other region
Autofill panel shows suggestions with source and accept/reject per field
Completeness meter updates after each step from the API
Playwright test completes the wizard against a mocked API

title: Adapter framework: SourceAdapter protocol, types, registry, sources and source_runs
acceptance: adapters/base.py defines SourceAdapter Protocol exactly as SPEC 5.1, RawRecord, DocumentRef, OpportunityIn (Pydantic), AdapterHealth
Registry maps source_id -> adapter class; sources table rows created on startup for each registered adapter
source_runs(source_id, started_at, finished_at, status, fetched, upserted, errors jsonb, watermark, cursor)
Watermark helper returns since = last_posted_at - 2 days
A minimal FixtureAdapter used by tests proves the pipeline end-to-end

title: Polite HTTP client: rate limits, backoff, robots.txt, raw payload archive
acceptance: Token-bucket limiter per host; default 1 req/s for .gov.in hosts and configurable quota for api.sam.gov
Exponential backoff with jitter on 429/5xx up to 5 attempts; Retry-After honoured
User-Agent 'BidRadar/<version> (+mailto:CONTACT_EMAIL)'
robots.txt fetched and cached per host; disallowed path raises RobotsDisallowed
Every response archived to raw/{source}/... via the storage service; archive path returned to the caller
Tests use respx/httpx mocks; no network

title: Canonical opportunity tables
acceptance: Migration 0003 creates opportunities with every 5.3 column, unique (source_id, external_id), embedding vector(1024), trigram index on title, GIN full-text index
opportunity_versions(opportunity_id, version, diff jsonb, content_hash, created_at)
opportunity_documents(opportunity_id, file_name, url, hash, size, pages, status, parsed_text_ref) and document_chunks(document_id, page, text, embedding)
awards_enrichment(opportunity_id, incumbent, prior_award_value, prior_pop_end, num_offers, source_ref)
Opportunities are global (no tenant_id) but documents parsed text is shared; test confirms RLS not applied to opportunities

title: SAM.gov opportunities adapter with incremental watermark
acceptance: fetch() paginates with limit=1000 and offset until totalRecords reached
postedFrom = watermark - 2 days, MM/dd/yyyy format; window never exceeds 1 year
fixture tests/adapters/fixtures/sam_opps/page1.json normalizes to OpportunityIn rows with notice_type mapped from type codes p,o,k,r,s,i,a,u,g
amendment with same solicitationNumber links parent_opportunity_id
429 response triggers backoff and resumes from cursor

title: SAM.gov description and resourceLinks documents
acceptance: fetch_detail pulls the description link and stores description_text
fetch_documents returns a DocumentRef per resourceLinks entry with file name inferred from headers or URL
Buyer hierarchy mapped to buyer_org, buyer_sub_org, buyer_office and buyer_hierarchy[]
Contacts, set_aside, naics/psc, place_of_performance and response deadline (with source tz) mapped; fixture-driven tests

title: Grants.gov adapter
acceptance: search2 POST paginates posted and forecasted opportunities; schedule every 2h
fetchOpportunity enriches eligibility, award ceiling/floor, close date, ALN codes
When two records exist for one opportunity only the latest version is kept
notice_type grant or forecast; fixture tests for both

title: USAspending adapter and agency spend statistics
acceptance: POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ paged with page size 100 and stops at 50,000 results
Weekly job aggregates obligations by agency x NAICS x PSC for the last 3 FY into agency_spend_stats
Expiring contracts (period_of_performance end in 6-18 months) recorded for recompete watch
Fixture tests; DoD lag note surfaced in AdapterHealth

title: SAM.gov contract awards adapter and opportunity enrichment
acceptance: Daily fetch of awards by NAICS list via SAM API key; nothing references FPDS
Enrichment links awards to opportunities by solicitation number or NAICS+agency and fills incumbent, prior_award_value, prior_pop_end, num_offers
Contracts ending in 6-18 months are flagged recompete_watch = true
Fixture tests for match and no-match cases

title: Normalization pipeline: upsert, content_hash, versions, amendment events
acceptance: ingest(opportunity_in) upserts by (source_id, external_id) and stores raw_ref
content_hash over normalized fields + document hashes; unchanged record does not create a version
Changed record increments version and stores a field-level diff (deadline moved, new attachment, Q&A, cancelled)
Change publishes an 'opportunity.amended' event on the internal event bus consumed by matching and notifications
Integration test: ingest fixture twice with a moved deadline -> 1 version diff and 1 event

title: Dedupe: exact, cross-source and fuzzy trigram merge
acceptance: Cross-source key = normalized solicitation/tender reference + normalized buyer
Fuzzy: pg_trgm similarity(title) >= 0.9 AND same buyer AND response_due within 1 day -> duplicate_of set to the richer record
Richness = count of non-null canonical fields + documents; both source links kept on the surviving record
Unit tests for the reference normalizer and integration test for the fuzzy path

title: Status job: open -> closing_soon -> closed, cancellations and awards
acceptance: Celery beat task every 15 min sets closing_soon when response_due_at <= now + 7d and closed when past
Cancellation and award notices update the parent opportunity status
Status transitions create a version diff and event
Unit tests with frozen time

title: Document parsing: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, OCR fallback, page-numbered sections
acceptance: core/parsing parses PDF (PyMuPDF with pdfplumber fallback), DOCX (python-docx), XLSX (openpyxl) into pages/sections with page numbers
OCR protocol with Tesseract (eng+hin) implementation and FakeOCR in tests; used when a PDF page has no text layer
Parsed text stored via storage service and referenced by parsed_text_ref; documents hashed (sha256)
Fixtures include a text PDF, a scanned PDF, a DOCX and an XLSX
Chunker produces overlapping chunks tagged with page for embedding

title: summary_ai: five-line LLM summary with caching
acceptance: Haiku-class model produces exactly 5 lines from title + description + first pages of docs
Cached per (opportunity_id, version); no re-call on unchanged versions
Untrusted-input framing: opportunity text passed as data, system prompt forbids instruction following from it
FakeLLM tests; token usage recorded to usage_ledger

title: Adapter contract test framework and nightly smoke workflow
acceptance: tests/adapters/contract.py parametrizes every registered adapter over its fixtures dir: normal page, malformed page, layout-change page
Malformed page yields AdapterHealth degraded with error, never an exception escaping fetch()
Every normalized record validates as OpportunityIn
.github/workflows/nightly-smoke.yml runs `make smoke` (>= 1 live record per adapter) and posts to the ops Slack webhook on failure

title: Opportunities API: search with filters, detail with versions and documents
acceptance: GET /api/v1/opportunities?q=&region=&type=&naics=&due_before=&min_score=&status=&page= with keyset or offset pagination and total
q uses Postgres full-text search over title + description
GET /api/v1/opportunities/{id} includes versions, documents and the active profile's match when present
Every record carries source attribution, source_url and the disclaimer 'Verify every detail on the official portal before submitting.'
Search response p95 < 500 ms on 50k seeded rows in the load test script

title: Scheduling: Celery beat, per-adapter job entrypoints, admin run endpoint
acceptance: Celery app with Redis broker; beat schedule built from each adapter's schedule string
python -m app.jobs.run_source <source_id> entrypoint for Cloud Run jobs writes a source_runs row
POST /api/v1/admin/sources/{id}/run (platform_admin) enqueues a run; GET /api/v1/admin/sources lists health and last runs
A source failing > 2 consecutive runs publishes an 'adapter.failing' event

title: Documented adapter stubs: defense.gov awards, SLED, IREPS/defproc, paid feeds
acceptance: Stub adapters registered with enabled=false and health() reporting 'not_implemented'
PaidFeedAdapter base takes a tenant-supplied licence key from Secret Manager reference; HigherGov, GovSpend, BidNet, TenderTiger, Tender247, BidAssist subclasses documented
docs/adapters.md explains how to implement a new adapter and the compliance rules
Contract tests skip disabled adapters explicitly

title: Frontend: opportunity search and detail screens
acceptance: Search page: filter sidebar, TanStack results table (score, title, buyer, value, due, type, source), saved-search bar
Detail page: summary, fit score breakdown placeholder, eligibility checks, documents viewer, versions/diff, Pursue/Watch/Pass actions
Due dates shown in the user's time zone with the buyer's alongside
Disclaimer and source link visible on every record

title: India date, time zone and money utilities
acceptance: core.dates.parse_in parses DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY and '17-Jul-2026 08:23 PM' as IST and returns UTC with source tz kept
core.money.parse_inr parses '₹12,50,000', 'Rs. 1.2 Cr', '12.5 Lakh' to Decimal; format_inr renders lakh/crore grouping
to_usd(amount, currency) uses a configurable FX table (FX_RATES setting) and records the rate used
Overnight US deadline renders as '2:00 PM EDT = 11:30 PM IST' via core.dates.dual_tz

title: CPPP adapter over captcha-free listing pages
acceptance: Reads only 'Latest active tenders' and 'Tenders by Organisation' pages; no search form, no archive, no CAPTCHA endpoints
Parses tender id, reference no., title, organisation, published/closing/opening dates, corrigendum flag, detail and document links when captcha-free
Detail requiring CAPTCHA sets detail_status='manual' and stores portal search URL
Rate limit 1 req/s; robots.txt respected; fixtures include a layout-change page
Schedule every 3h

title: GeM adapter: ongoing bid listing and bid PDF download
acceptance: Reads the public bid listing (recorded JSON/HTML fixture) without login
Each bid yields OpportunityIn with notice_type gem_bid or reverse_auction, bid number, ministry/department, end date IST
fetch_documents downloads the bid PDF and hashes it
Schedule every 3h; GeM seller registration link surfaced in source_url

title: GeM bid PDF extraction with LLM and page citations
acceptance: Extractor returns eligibility jsonb: item/service, quantity, estimated value, EMD, turnover criterion, experience criterion, MSE/startup exemptions, bid end date, consignee locations, each with page citation
Opus-class model via JSON schema; invalid output retried up to 2x then flagged
Golden GeM fixtures: exact match >= 90% on turnover, EMD and experience fields
Values parsed with core.money.parse_inr

title: GePNIC generic adapter with Telangana, Karnataka and Maharashtra configs
acceptance: One GePNICAdapter class parameterized by config (base_url, org list pages, date formats, source_id gepnic_ts|gepnic_ka|gepnic_mh)
Configs in backend/app/adapters/gepnic_configs.yaml; adding a state is config only
Fixtures per portal parse to OpportunityIn; malformed page degrades health
Per-tender links stored with portal search URL fallback

title: India dedupe: CPPP mirrors and transliterated organisation names
acceptance: Organisation normalizer maps common transliterations and abbreviations (e.g. 'Govt.'/'Government', 'Dept'/'Department', 'Nigam'/'Corporation') before comparison
CPPP record mirroring a state or GeM tender merges with duplicate_of pointing to the richer record and both links kept
Unit tests with Hindi/English mixed titles

title: Hindi and bilingual content handling
acceptance: Devanagari titles and PDFs pass through parsing, hashing and chunking without errors (fixtures)
OCR language set eng+hin for IN region documents
Optional Hindi summary generated when profile languages include 'hi' (FakeLLM test)

title: India eligibility rules: turnover, EMD, MSME/Udyam and Startup exemptions
acceptance: core.eligibility.evaluate_in(profile, criteria) returns pass/fail/unknown per criterion with reasons
Udyam-registered MSE gets EMD exemption and turnover/experience relaxation when criteria allow
DPIIT startup gets prior-turnover/experience relaxation only when the tender flag allows
Turnover compared as average of last 3 FY in INR; expired DSC or missing GeM ID yields a blocking warning
Table-driven unit tests

title: India fixtures, contract tests and live smoke
acceptance: Recorded fixtures for cppp, gem, gepnic_ts, gepnic_ka, gepnic_mh including malformed and layout-change pages
Contract tests green for all India adapters
make smoke includes the India adapters and passes when run against live portals (documented manual run)

title: Source attribution, link-back and disclaimers for India records
acceptance: Every IN opportunity response includes attribution text naming the portal and the official link
Exports and emails carry the same attribution and the verify-on-portal disclaimer
docs/legal.md records the requirement for a written legal opinion before commercial resale of Indian portal data

title: matches table and stage 1 hard filters
acceptance: Migration creates matches(tenant_id, profile_id, opportunity_id, opportunity_version, profile_version, score, band, breakdown jsonb, rationale jsonb, filtered_reason, created_at) unique per (profile, opportunity, versions)
core.matching.hard_filters drops on region, notice type, blocked buyer, past response date (unless recompete watch) and exclusion keywords
Ineligible set-aside is kept, capped at 30 and labelled 'Ineligible: set-aside'
Table-driven unit tests for each filter

title: Stage 2 weighted score with per-profile weights
acceptance: Eight signals with default weights 25/25/10/15/5/5/5/10 and profile overrides
Code match: exact NAICS/PSC/ALN/GeM = 1.0, same 4-digit NAICS = 0.6
Value fit inside range = 1, within 2x = 0.5; geography in target list or remote = 1; buyer affinity past customer or target = 1
Band High >= 70, Medium 50-69, Low < 50; breakdown jsonb lists each signal's raw and weighted value
Unit tests reach 100% of core/matching

title: Semantic similarity, keyword BM25 and past-performance relevance signals
acceptance: Opportunity embedding computed on title + summary + requirements at ingest (batch)
Semantic signal = max cosine vs profile service-line embeddings (pgvector <=> operator)
Keyword signal = weighted include keywords via Postgres ts_rank_cd over title + description + parsed docs, normalized 0-1
Past-performance signal = best cosine vs past_performance embeddings
Integration test with FakeEmbeddings verifies ordering

title: Eligibility signal from extracted criteria
acceptance: Compares turnover, experience years, certifications, registrations and size status against opportunity.eligibility
Missing data on either side scores 0.5 and is reported as unknown
US path uses SBA size status; IN path uses evaluate_in
Per-criterion results stored in breakdown.eligibility for the UI pass/fail/unknown list

title: Stage 3 LLM rationale as strict JSON with caching
acceptance: Only scores >= 50 call the model (LLM_MODEL_RATIONALE setting)
Output schema: fit_summary (3 bullets), matched_capabilities[], gaps[] each with suggested_fix, eligibility_risks[] with page citations, recommended_action pursue|watch|pass, confidence 0-1
Invalid JSON retried up to 2x then rationale=null with flag
Cached by (opportunity version, profile version); FakeLLM test asserts one call for two scorings

title: Match trigger and batch scoring job
acceptance: opportunity.created/amended events enqueue scoring against every active profile in the region with completeness >= 40
Profile change re-scores open opportunities for that profile
Batch job scores 200 profiles x 50k opportunities in < 10 min in the load script (hard filters in SQL, stage 2 vectorized)
Emits match.high / match.medium events with band and score

title: Match feedback and weekly keyword re-tune suggestions
acceptance: POST /api/v1/opportunities/{id}/feedback stores match_feedback(thumb up|down, reason text)
Weekly job computes keyword lift from feedback and writes keyword_suggestions(profile_id, term, kind, delta_weight, evidence)
Suggestions are never auto-applied; owner approves via PUT /profiles/{id}/keyword-suggestions/{id}
Unit test on the lift computation

title: Saved searches and alert rules
acceptance: GET/POST /api/v1/saved-searches stores the filter set; each saved search creates an alert_rules row
GET/POST /api/v1/alert-rules with min_score, channels, instant|digest
New matches are evaluated against every alert rule of the tenant and produce notification events
Isolation factories registered

title: Notification core: events, idempotency, deliveries, retries and fallback
acceptance: notifications(tenant_id, user_id, event_type, opportunity_id, pursuit_id, version, payload jsonb, created_at) and notification_deliveries(channel, status queued|sent|failed|opened, idempotency_key unique, attempts, error)
Idempotency key = (user, event_type, opportunity_id, version); duplicate events are no-ops
Channel protocol send(delivery) -> result; failed sends retry 3x with backoff then fall back to email
Every notification payload includes deep link and one-click actions Pursue, Watch, Pass (with reason), Assign as signed action URLs
Delivery within 5 minutes of scoring asserted in the integration test with a fake clock

title: Email channel: SES/SendGrid providers, templates, unsubscribe
